name: MedOrbits
description: Inventory and implementation policy for the MedOrbits education, admissions, career, recruitment, and consultancy platform. Intended paths are not confirmed unless their status is verified.

statusSemantics.planned: Intended item; existence and implementation are not verified.
statusSemantics.existing: Verified at the declared repository-relative path in the current checkout.
statusSemantics.deprecated: Existing item scheduled for removal; replacement and removal plan must be documented.
statusSemantics.missing: Expected item was checked for and not found; record a reason.
statusSemantics.ignored: Path is excluded by Git ignore rules and is not expected to be committed in its current form.

authenticationRequirements: Hash passwords using an established password-hashing algorithm.
Expire and rate-limit OTPs; never log or commit OTP values.
Enforce server-side authorization for every protected operation.
Use secure session or token handling and appropriate cookie settings.
uploadRequirements: Validate file type, size, and content where feasible.
Store private applicant documents outside public web roots.
Use access controls and short-lived download links where applicable.
Define retention and deletion rules for personal data.

rules: Only document commands that are configured or explicitly label them as examples.
Do not mark tests as passing unless they have run successfully.
Keep automated checks aligned with actual package scripts.
Do not commit generated reports or runtime artifacts unless required.
Use the lint configuration format supported by the installed ESLint version; verify the config before requiring it.

git.requiredTrackedFilesArePolicy: Intended baseline only; verify each path before enforcing it in CI.

manifestValidation.validationMustRunBeforeMerge: Only after a JSON Schema validator and CI command have been configured.

notes: This manifest documents intended structure; it does not prove that listed paths exist.
All paths are relative to the repository root.
Use planned until a path has been verified in the working tree or repository.
Git tracks files, not empty directories. Add a meaningful file or intentional .gitkeep placeholder when an otherwise empty directory must be represented.
A .gitkeep file is a convention, not a special Git feature.
The root server.js, src/app.js, and index.html must have clearly documented responsibilities and a verified production startup command.
Use MySQL consistently if it is the selected database engine.
Keep private uploads and application records outside publicly served asset directories.
Do not use force-add commands to bypass ignore rules for secrets or private data.
The repository root name is determined by the actual checkout directory; repositoryRoot is set to . rather than a hard-coded folder name.
manifest.json contains inventory data; manifest.schema.json validates its structure.
ESLint configuration filenames depend on the installed ESLint version; verify the actual configuration before marking it existing.
Do not add a CI validation command until the validator dependency and script are configured.
